lessons_used: Predictions underpredicted gains on winning tests while being overoptimistic for non-winning tests.
sign_in hint changes were helpful, winning 3 of 5 tests.
home wait_info changes were helpful, winning both tests.
choose_path copy changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
home redesign changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Evidence remains thin for all other specific change types as they lack at least 2 agreeing tests.

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Interaction Onboarding Card
candidates.change: Adds a new interactive guide screen before final completion explaining how to control, hide, and interact with the desktop pet.
candidates.why: Support receives multiple emails regarding confusion on how to control or hide pets after onboarding, and the finish step conversion is only 64.8%.

new_interaction_guide.headline: Interact With Your Desktop Companion
new_interaction_guide.body: Learn how to right-click for options, drag your pet around screen edges, or hide it to system tray.

guard.reason: new screens need an _order that places them

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Signature Stage Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the adoption certificate screen into a stage layout featuring an official companion badge.
candidates.why: Adoption drop-off is high with only 66.0% conversion and 89s median completion time.

guard.reason: Redesigning the adoption certificate layout while retaining an official verification badge fulfills the required job.

candidates.score_note: High drop-off step, but visual redesigns show weak/mixed evidence across tests.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Interactive Mini Game Flow
candidates.change: Introduces an interactive tip and mini-game sub-flow while waiting for desktop pet generation.
candidates.why: Users spend a median of 201s (mean 2336s) on the waiting screen, leading to high drop-off.

waiting.hint: Play a mini game while your pet finishes rendering on desktop!

guard.reason: Adding a mini game sub-flow while preserving the pet rendering wait status is allowed.

candidates.score_note: High development effort for mini-game flow on a step with lower overall drop-off.

candidates.title: Story Screen Hero Showcase Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the story introduction screen using a full-bleed visual layout with animated hero preview.
candidates.why: The choose_path step sees a 21.7% drop-off right at the start of onboarding.

guard.reason: Redesigning the story screen layout while still introducing the desktop pet is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Choose_path redesigns historically showed slightly negative impact (-0.8%).

candidates.title: Sign-In Multi-Device Pet Sync Hint
candidates.change: Displays a hint reassuring users that signing in syncs existing pets across devices.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in, and sign_in hints won 3 of 5 earlier tests.

sign_in.hint: Signing in restores all your previously adopted pets and desktop settings automatically.

guard.reason: Adding a sign-in sync hint is a allowed modification within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Backed by 8 support emails and sign_in hints won 3 of 5 previous tests.

candidates.title: Background Rendering Status Wait Indicator
candidates.change: Shows live progress percentage and estimated remaining seconds while pet assets render.
candidates.why: Home wait step takes median 201s and wait_info changes previously won both tests.

waiting.hint: Generating desktop companion assets and initializing pet physics engine...

guard.reason: Displaying live wait time estimates for real processing does not violate fair design rules.

candidates.score_note: Wait_info changes won both prior tests with +3.1% average lift during pet generation.

candidates.title: Photo Preparation Clarity Hint
candidates.change: Adds guidance on photo contrast and lighting on the photo upload screen.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failing or looking wrong during adoption.

upload_photos.hint: For best results, upload clear front-facing photos with good lighting and clear contrast.

candidates.title: Desktop Hatching Completion Audio Alert
candidates.change: Triggers a audio alert chime and notification when pet generation completes on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Users idle for long periods (mean 2336s) during asset rendering and miss when the pet is ready.

guard.reason: Adding completion audio alerts and notifications to the waiting screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Home notification changes consistently perform well (+3.5% across 2 tests) for long wait steps.

candidates.title: Welcome Launch Pet Accessory Reward
candidates.change: Gives a free party hat accessory badge upon reaching the final desktop launch screen.
candidates.why: Finish conversion drops to 64.8%, leaving overall onboarding completion at only 25.6%.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Ready for Desktop!
home_intro.body: You unlocked a free starter companion hat for completing setup!

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions a 'free' accessory reward, violating pricing/copy rules.

candidates.title: Choose Path Companion Trait Headline Copy
candidates.change: Clarifies personality and trait selection options on the path choice screen.
candidates.why: Choose path drops 21.7% of users in median 8 seconds, indicating potential decision hesitation.

choose_path.headline: Select Your Companion Personality & Path
choose_path.body: Choose whether you want an active desktop helper or a cozy background friend.

guard.reason: Replaces the path choice options so it no longer offers both adopting and making your own pet.

lessons_next: Predictions underpredicted gains on winning tests while remaining overoptimistic for non-winning tests.

choose_path copy changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
